in_sanskrit.name: कृष्णेन्दु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: कृष्ण-नद् (Krishna-nad) meaning 'Lord Krishna' + इन्दु (Indu) meaning 'companion, friend' = कृष्णेन्दु (Krishnendu) meaning 'Lord Krishna's compassionate one'

in_hindi.name: कृष्णेन्दु
in_hindi.long_meaning: श्री कृष्ण (Shree Krishna) + सहायक (sahayak) = कृष्णेन्दु (Krishnendu) meaning 'Lord Krishna's companion'

in_tamil.name: கிருஷ்ணேந்து
in_tamil.long_meaning: கிருஷ்ணன் (Krishnan) + விடுதலையாளவ் (vithudalaiyalav) = கிருஷ்ணேந்து (Krishnendu) meaning 'Lord Krishna's companion'

in_telugu.name: కృష్ణేందు
in_telugu.long_meaning: శ్రీ కృష్ణ్ (Shree Krishna) + సేవయోదు (sevayodu) = కృష్ణేందు (Krishnendu) meaning 'Lord Krishna's servant'

in_marathi.name: Krishnendu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's grace, divine gift
in_marathi.long_meaning: Krishnendu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Krishnendu is a name derived from Sanskrit, originating from the Hindu tradition. It is a compound of two words: Krishna, which means 'dark' or 'black' in Hindi, representing the divine, and endu, which means 'inner' or 'within'. The name Krishnendu is believed to signify 'God's grace within us' or 'a divine gift'.
